question1.text: Hard and smooth objects absorb most of the sound waves.

question2.text: When the same sound is heard more than once, it is called an echo.

question3.text: Curved and soft objects placed in halls help to create echoes and reverberations.

question4.text: Bats and dolphins use reverberations of sound to hunt or navigate.

question5.text: Sound waves travel more slowly in cold water than in warm water.
